title: D-087 pre-mount route hardening: ONE shared bounded rate limiter (app/resilience/rate_limit.py) replacing the three route-local limiters, rate-limit before parsing, bounded in-flight jobs, disabled-means-404 for every method, and the OpenAPI-absence pin (DB-080 a-c, DB-081 a-e, DB-082 b, d, e) - routes stay UNMOUNTED
objective: Close the route-side PKT-H (mount) preconditions in the three UNMOUNTED routes (app/api/v1/scene_api.py, dxf_import_api.py, export_api.py). (1) Build ONE shared, bounded, thread-safe sliding-window limiter in services/api/app/resilience/rate_limit.py and replace all three route-local limiters with it: per-route limits unchanged (30 per 60 s today), a declared key ceiling, idle/expired keys evicted, and when the table is still full of ACTIVE keys the NEW key is refused (fail-closed) - an active key's history is never evicted (that would reset its window). (2) ONE caller-key function: the authenticated principal when the request carries one (PKT-H adds auth), else the caller host - the proxy-collapse limit (DB-080 b) disclosed in the docstring. (3) The limiter runs BEFORE any body or parameter parsing on every route (DB-081 b: a malformed /dxf-import/draft must not get a 422 before the limiter). (4) A bounded in-flight job cap per route: a job abandoned by the deadline keeps its slot until its thread really finishes, so abandoned threads cannot pile up (DB-082 b); over the cap = a typed refusal. (5) While the flag is off, EVERY HTTP method on these paths returns the generic 404 byte-identical to an unmounted path (DB-081 d), proven on a throwaway app that includes the router. (6) Pin include_in_schema=False with a test that includes each router in a throwaway FastAPI app and asserts none of its paths appear in openapi() (DB-080 c, DB-082 d). (7) DB-081 e: align the pre-render guard's utf-8 encode step with its sibling or record why it is unreachable. (8) DB-081 c / DB-082 e: record per route the body ceiling vs the parser's own caps with the arithmetic; change a ceiling only if a legitimate maximum input is refused AND the parser caps bound the work - otherwise keep it and route the finding.
business_reason: The 3D scene, DXF import and CAD export routes are built but not in the app; PKT-H (the mount) waits on these route-safety riders. Closing them in one packet makes the mount a small, reviewable step.
